scope: Methodological references, not a performance ranking. No external suite was executed for this review. Differences are PALO maintainer assessments of documented scope, not proof of absence of features elsewhere.

discovery.name: terryyz/llm-benchmark
discovery.role: Bibliographic directory; not a benchmark result or endorsement. All 12 listed entries are accounted for; historical dataset counts are not copied as current facts.

palo_status.implemented: Evidence schema, annotation consistency, raw-output binding, calculated task acceptance, structural replay and historical configuration explorer.
palo_status.proposed: Procurement specification-fidelity study, independently adjudicated unseen cases, critical-rule inversion analysis and measured human correction effort.
palo_status.open_gates: External preregistration/custody, independent annotation, metric calibration, proposition-bank reuse and family-aware uncertainty.

entries.name: HELM
entries.focus: Broad scenario and metric coverage for foundation models.
entries.evidence: Public framework, prompts/responses inspection and leaderboards.
entries.palo_difference: PALO proposes a narrower procurement specification-fidelity study. Multi-dimensional evaluation is established prior art.
entries.lesson: Retain scenario, adapter, model and metric versions.
entries.source_status: README reports maintenance mode since June 2026.

entries.name: BIG-bench
entries.focus: Collaborative tasks probing diverse language-model capabilities.
entries.evidence: Public tasks, evaluation code and published experiments.
entries.palo_difference: PALO targets business-rule preservation in a reviewed specification, rather than broad capability coverage.
entries.lesson: Use explicit task definitions and diverse independently selected cases.
entries.source_status: Repository archived on 17 April 2026; retained as historical prior art.

entries.name: BigBIO
entries.focus: Harmonised biomedical datasets and task schemas.
entries.evidence: Dataloaders, provenance, licensing metadata and dataset documentation.
entries.palo_difference: A dataset library is a reference for corpus governance, not a competing procurement-specification score.
entries.lesson: Document source rights, schema mappings and provenance.

entries.name: BigScience Evaluation
entries.focus: Task-based language-model evaluation, including translation and question answering.
entries.evidence: Code, task abstractions and evaluation instructions.
entries.palo_difference: PALO adds a scoped evidence contract for annotated business propositions; it has not demonstrated broader capability coverage.
entries.lesson: Keep task-specific evaluation separate from model execution.
entries.source_status: README retains 2021 milestones; no current deployment qualification inferred.

entries.name: LM Evaluation Harness
entries.focus: Configurable execution of academic language-model tasks across backends.
entries.evidence: Task configurations, model adapters, metrics and sample logging.
entries.palo_difference: This is reusable execution infrastructure. PALO supplies a proposed domain-specific task and adjudication contract; no integration is claimed.
entries.lesson: Reuse configuration discipline and record prompt, backend and generation settings.

entries.name: Scholar Evals
entries.focus: Scope could not be verified from the referenced repository.
entries.evidence: The referenced repository returned HTTP 404 during this review.
entries.palo_difference: No capability comparison or judgement of benchmark quality is made from an unavailable source.
entries.lesson: Preserve the discovery reference and mark unknown evidence explicitly.
entries.source_status: Unavailable at the referenced URL; reason unknown.

entries.name: BigCode Evaluation Harness
entries.focus: Code generation and related coding tasks, including unit-test-based evaluation.
entries.evidence: Task implementations, generation/evaluation tooling and container instructions.
entries.palo_difference: Correct code against supplied tests does not establish that the originating business requirement was interpreted faithfully.
entries.lesson: Keep code-test outcomes separate from source-rule fidelity.

entries.name: Chatbot Arena / Arena
entries.focus: Model comparison with uncertainty-aware score and rank presentation.
entries.evidence: Published ranking methodology and confidence/rank intervals.
entries.palo_difference: PALO proposes source-based adjudication of obligations and exceptions; preference and semantic fidelity answer different questions.
entries.lesson: Show uncertainty and avoid treating a small numerical ordering as a stable ranking.
entries.source_status: Current methodology checked; directory points to historical FastChat infrastructure.

entries.name: GLUE
entries.focus: General natural-language understanding across multiple tasks.
entries.evidence: Task suite, analysis platform and published methodology.
entries.palo_difference: PALO examines source-to-specification transformations and the correction burden within a business domain.
entries.lesson: Use task-specific gold and publish per-task results.
entries.source_status: The directory links jiant, an implementation toolkit whose README says it is no longer actively maintained.

entries.name: SuperGLUE
entries.focus: More challenging general language-understanding tasks following GLUE.
entries.evidence: Benchmark tasks, evaluation methodology and analysis resources.
entries.palo_difference: PALO is narrower and currently unqualified; neither general NLU performance nor PALO diagnostics imply success on the other.
entries.lesson: Define acceptance and task difficulty before comparing systems.
entries.source_status: Distinguish the benchmark from the jiant implementation linked by the directory.

entries.name: CLUE
entries.focus: Chinese-language understanding through representative classification and reading tasks.
entries.evidence: Datasets, baselines, task metrics and leaderboards.
entries.palo_difference: PALO has not qualified multilingual specification fidelity. Country of model origin is not a language-quality measurement.
entries.lesson: Treat language and localisation as explicit evaluation conditions.

entries.name: CodeXGLUE
entries.focus: Code understanding and generation, including code/text transformations.
entries.evidence: Task datasets, baselines and evaluation resources.
entries.palo_difference: PALO proposes checking the business meaning before code is produced; code/text overlap is acknowledged.
entries.lesson: Separate transformation types and use outcome-appropriate metrics.

entries.name: Vals AI
entries.focus: Industry-oriented tasks and model comparisons across professional domains.
entries.evidence: Published benchmark pages and methodologies; some benchmarks are proprietary.
entries.palo_difference: Enterprise evaluation is already established. PALO proposes a specific document-to-specification fidelity study, without claiming broader coverage or superior validation.
entries.lesson: Use realistic tasks and make public/private evidence boundaries explicit.

entries.name: Artificial Analysis
entries.focus: Quality, intelligence, performance and price of models, endpoints and systems.
entries.evidence: Published measurement definitions and comparative results.
entries.palo_difference: PALO records configuration-specific evidence and proposes workflow correction effort; current cost records are not full enterprise cost measurements.
entries.lesson: Distinguish model, serving endpoint and complete system.

entries.name: OfficeQA
entries.focus: Complex questions over real-world financial documents.
entries.evidence: Evaluation code and corpus tooling; source documents, parsed data and gated answer sets are documented.
entries.palo_difference: A close comparator. PALO proposes evaluating the resulting specification and altered rules, rather than only answers to questions.
entries.lesson: Separate parsing, retrieval and reasoning; keep unseen document families.

entries.name: DABstep
entries.focus: Multi-step business data analysis with factoid answers.
entries.evidence: Tasks, answer-format requirements and automated answer checks.
entries.palo_difference: PALO propositions can admit multiple legitimate formulations and require semantic adjudication; answer normalisation alone is insufficient.
entries.lesson: Use deterministic checks where valid, without confusing formatting with correctness.

entries.name: OmniDocBench
entries.focus: Document parsing, including text, tables, formulas and layout.
entries.evidence: Annotated document data and evaluation tooling.
entries.palo_difference: Parsing is an upstream component; PALO proposes checking whether extracted content retains its business meaning in a specification.
entries.lesson: Measure extraction independently from interpretation.

entries.name: SWE-bench Verified
entries.focus: Resolution of repository issues using a human-validated task subset.
entries.evidence: Task definitions, evaluation resources and published agent results.
entries.palo_difference: PALO focuses on interpreting the source requirement before implementation; passing software tests addresses a different evaluation stage.
entries.lesson: Freeze the harness and distinguish model comparisons from whole-agent comparisons.

entries.name: FACTS Grounding
entries.focus: Factual grounding of generated responses in supplied documents.
entries.evidence: Published benchmark and multi-judge evaluation methodology.
entries.palo_difference: A close semantic comparator. PALO proposes domain-specific critical-rule inversions and human repair effort; that additional value still needs validation.
entries.lesson: Calibrate semantic judging against independent reference decisions.

entries.name: Andon Labs Blueprint-Bench 2
entries.focus: Reconstruction of apartment floor plans from photographs.
entries.evidence: Published task description, connectivity metric and leaderboard.
entries.palo_difference: Distinct project and meaning of blueprint: spatial floor plans versus business development specifications. No affiliation or shared score.
entries.lesson: Disambiguate the name and compare only commensurate tasks.

supporting_sources.purpose: Distinguish toolkit maintenance status from GLUE/SuperGLUE task definitions.
Historical Chatbot Arena infrastructure linked by the discovery directory; current comparison uses Arena methodology.
